notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Lost Nova has been out for 3 years! That's wild and strange to me. To celebrate, here's a small update for ya:

- improved performance, particularly when playing on laptops and lower-end systems
- improved load times
- added Borderless Fullscreen option

Thanks for playing my first game. Check out my other games too if you haven't yet. I'm working on my 4th one now :)
Jon

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
- band friends no longer appear during the pumpkin event
- removed an unwelcome NPC from the museum
- adjusted seed store interaction range
- adjusted collision walls in Roomwoods
- adjusted pushable blocks to behave more consistently with the player's laser
- adjusted jumping collision detection
- updated goo slime's dialogue
- fixed rare iceberg robot disappearance
- fixed a bear child being off screen under extremely specific circumstances
- auto saving no longer occurs if the player is inside of a rock for some reason (or any other place that you would traditionally not want to be inside forever)

notes.title: Patch 1.014
notes.notes:
- moved a rock in the hub area a little to the left
- updated Painted Desert ground textures
- fixed crystal deposits being invulnerable to beam damage
- fixed inconsistent ocean dock collisions
- fixed the rare ship leaving their pilot behind
- fixed store item description alignment
- adjusted some collision walls in the Sky Plains
- adjusted mouse cursor size

notes.title: Patch 1.013
notes.notes:
- updated speedy beet store description
- gamepad controls added to options
- vignettes on/off added to options
- fixed player silhouette drawing incorrectly in some situations

notes.title: Hotfix 1.012b
notes.notes:
- fixed fashion boots being too fabulous and causing a crash
- fixed ocean buoy collision

notes.title: Hotfix 1.012
notes.notes:
- credits updated
- dialogue updates, corrections, and adjustments
- fixed some desert rocks to be easier to jump over
- fixed player sprite facing on loading a save
- fixed rare crash after repeated save loads while using a gamepad

notes.title: Hotfix 1.011a
notes.notes: - Fixed rare occurences of getting stuck in ocean coral

notes.title: Lost Nova Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Lost Nova just received a release date AND a new trailer!

[previewyoutube=X4whGG77e4o;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm super excited to finally announce the release date for Lost Nova:
[h2]🌟 MAY 11TH! 2022! 🌟[/h2]

Lost Nova will be launching on Steam and if you'd like a reminder on launch day (and other updates on me and my games), join my [url=https://lostnovagame.com/demo/]mailing list[/url].

Thank you all for joining me on this adventure. I can't wait to finally share this world with you.

I hope to see you on launch day!
